skills.description: This skill should be used when users need to collect, integrate, analyze, and report intelligence and materials on any topic with a rigorous verification process. It covers business/market intelligence, academic/technical research, news/current affairs, and general information gathering. The skill enforces multi-source cross-verification, source credibility tiering, information synthesis, deep analysis (pattern recognition, causal analysis, competing-hypothesis analysis, scenario planning, SWOT/PEST), and comprehensive structured reporting with confidence ratings. It also includes compliance guardrails, misinformation handling, and a final quality-assurance gate. Trigger phrases include: collect intelligence, gather information, research topic, investigate, find reliable sources, verify claims, fact-check, analyze intelligence, synthesize information, 搜集情报, 收集资料, 调研, 核实信息, 情报收集, 资料整理, 情报分析, 情报整合, 分析汇报, 研究报告.
skills.description_zh: 收集、验证、筛选、整合、深度分析并汇报情报与资料的专业技能。强制多源交叉验证与来源可信度分级，覆盖商业/市场情报、学术/技术研究、新闻时事与通用信息，输出带置信度评级的完整分析报告。
skills.name: 情报与资料收集分析
